description: This Kotlin source file defines the ManageNotebooksFragment class, which manages the UI for displaying, sorting, and interacting with notebooks in an Android app. It includes setup for RecyclerView, menu options, sorting, and user interactions such as renaming, deleting, and selecting notebooks.

classes.name: ManageNotebooksFragment
classes.description: A fragment managing the display and interaction with notebooks, including sorting, selection, and actions like rename and delete.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes the fragment view, sets up RecyclerView, and menu interactions.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for sorting and creation actions.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections for creating notebooks and changing sort order.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Cleans up references when the view is destroyed.

methods.name: setupRecyclerView
methods.description: Configures RecyclerView, adapter, and user interaction handlers.

methods.name: enlistNotebooks
methods.description: Collects notebooks data and applies sorting based on user preferences.

methods.name: selectSortMethodItem
methods.description: Updates the menu to reflect the current sort method.
